sustained_by_rage.label: Sustained by Rage
sustained_by_rage.description: You cannot recover Damage. If you have not resolved an activation this round, you cannot be defeated.

system_shock_chopper.label: System Shock
system_shock_chopper.description: Use while on or adjacent to a terminal. Choose a figure on or adjacent to any terminal. That figure suffers 2 Damage and 1 Strain.
system_shock_chopper.logMessage: **System Shock** — Terminal adjacency enforced for both activator and target.

tactical_maneuver.label: Tactical Maneuver
tactical_maneuver.description: Choose a friendly figure within line of sight. That figure gains 2 movement points.

tactical_movement.label: Tactical Movement
tactical_movement.description: At the start of your activation, you may choose a friendly figure within 3 spaces. That figure gains 2 movement points.

Take Cover.label: Until end of round, +1 Block and -2 Accuracy when defending

Take Initiative.label: Claim the initiative token; then exhaust 1 of your Deployment cards

Take it Down.label: Special: choose adjacent friendly; that figure performs an attack with +2 Hits

Take Position.label: Until end of round: +1 Block when defending; cannot be pushed except by MASSIVE figures

take_cover_jawa_elite.label: Take Cover
take_cover_jawa_elite.description: While defending, you may apply +1 Block and -1 Evade to the defense results.

take_cover_jawa_reg.label: Take Cover
take_cover_jawa_reg.description: While defending, you may apply +1 Block and -1 Evade to the defense results.

targeting_computer_atst.label: Targeting Computer
targeting_computer_atst.description: While attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die.

targeting_computer_hk_elite.label: Targeting Computer
targeting_computer_hk_elite.description: While attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die.

targeting_computer_ig11.label: Targeting Computer
targeting_computer_ig11.description: While attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die.

targeting_computer_probe_elite.label: Targeting Computer
targeting_computer_probe_elite.description: While attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die.

targeting_computer_sentry_elite.label: Targeting Computer
targeting_computer_sentry_elite.description: While attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die.

targeting_computer_sentry_reg.label: Targeting Computer
targeting_computer_sentry_reg.description: While attacking, you may reroll 1 attack die.

Telekinetic Throw.label: Choose hostile within 3 with LOS: roll 2 blue dice, deal Hits as Damage

tempt.label: Tempt
tempt.description: Choose any figure within 4 spaces. That figure suffers 1 Damage and gains 1 Hit Token.

Terminal Network.label: While adjacent to a terminal: control all terminals until next round
Terminal Network.logMessage: **Terminal Network** — Until the start of next round, you control all terminals regardless of adjacency. Applies to mission objectives. Announce to opponent.

Terminal Protocol.label: Roll 1 green die; adjacent figures suffer Damage = result; activating figure defeated

the_force_is_with_me_chirrut.label: The Force is With Me
the_force_is_with_me_chirrut.description: When a Ranged attack targeting you is declared, choose an adjacent hostile figure. If you do, apply -1 Hit to the attack results and the chosen figure suffers 1 Damage.

There Is No Try.label: When a friendly REBEL FORCE USER rolls dice: set 1 die to any side + convert Dodge results
There Is No Try.logMessage: **There Is No Try** — When a friendly REBEL FORCE USER within 4 spaces rolls dice, choose one die and turn it to any side. On that die, convert each Dodge to 2 Blocks + 1 Evade. You will be prompted when a qualifying figure rolls dice.

To the Limit.label: After you resolve a Special Action: perform 1 additional action, then become Stunned

tonfa_strike.label: Tonfa Strike
tonfa_strike.description: Move up to 2 spaces, then perform a Melee attack using 1 red + 1 green die. After, you may perform an additional attack.
tonfa_strike.logMessage: **Tonfa Strike** — Gained 2 free MP. Your next attack is free and uses [Red, Green] dice (Melee). After it resolves, a second free attack is automatically granted.

Tools for the Job.label: Add 1 attack die to the attack pool

Tough Luck.label: After opponent rerolls a die: remove that die from the results
Tough Luck.logMessage: **Tough Luck** — After your opponent rerolls a die, remove that die's result entirely from the results. You will be prompted after each opponent reroll.

Toxic Dart.label: Choose hostile within 3 with LOS: apply 1 Strain + Weaken

trained_rancor.label: Trained
trained_rancor.description: While attacking, you may suffer 1 Strain to reroll 1 attack die.

trample_bantha.label: Trample
trample_bantha.description: Choose up to 3 adjacent hostile figures and roll 1 red die. Each suffers Damage equal to Hit results.
trample_bantha.rollOneDieNote: Deal Hit results as Damage to up to 3 adjacent hostile figures (automated).

Trandoshan Terror.label: Add 1 yellow die to attack pool (when declaring Indiscriminate Fire)

Transmit the Plans.label: Grant 2 Hit Tokens to activating figure; if adjacent terminal, gain 2 VP (use /editvp +2)

Triangulate.label: Move friendly DROIDs, then pick hostile in LOS — damage = # DROIDs in play
Triangulate.logMessage: **Triangulate** — Move your DROID figures first, then pick a hostile in LOS. It suffers Damage equal to the number of DROID figures in your squad in play.

tripod_eweb.label: Tripod
tripod_eweb.description: If you have been targeted by an attack this activation, you cannot exit your space. If you have exited your space this activation, you cannot attack.

trust_goes_both_ways_jyn.label: Trust Goes Both Ways
trust_goes_both_ways_jyn.description: When you activate, choose a friendly figure within 3 spaces to gain 1 MP.

tusken_cycler_elite.label: Tusken Cycler
tusken_cycler_elite.description: Perform a Ranged attack using 1 blue and 1 red die. Apply +2 Accuracy.
tusken_cycler_elite.logMessage: **Tusken Cycler** — Your next attack is free and uses [Blue, Red] dice (Ranged) with +2 Accuracy.

tusken_cycler_regular.label: Tusken Cycler
tusken_cycler_regular.description: Perform a Ranged attack using 1 blue and 1 red die. You cannot use abilities during this attack.
tusken_cycler_regular.logMessage: **Tusken Cycler** — Your next attack is free and uses [Blue, Red] dice (Ranged). Surge abilities blocked for this attack (automated).

twin_sabers_ahsoka.label: Twin Sabers
twin_sabers_ahsoka.description: While attacking, you may reroll all attack dice or force the defender to reroll all defense dice.

unhinged_director_krennic.label: Unhinged Director
unhinged_director_krennic.description: Friendly TROOPER or GUARDIAN within 2 spaces gain +2 (instead of +1) when spending power tokens.

Unlimited Power.label: When using Emperor: choose any friendly figure on the map instead of within 4 spaces
Unlimited Power.logMessage: **Unlimited Power** — When you use **Emperor**, you may choose any friendly figure on the map instead of one within 4 spaces. Play alongside Emperor.

unstable_devices_saska.label: Unstable Devices
unstable_devices_saska.description: At the start of each round, gain 1 device token. Automated in round.js.

Urgency.label: Gain movement points equal to Speed +2

Utinni!.label: Start of round: Jawa Scavengers +1 Speed, +1 Accuracy, Surge: gain 1 VP when attacking figure

vague_and_unconvincing_k2s0.label: Vague and Unconvincing
vague_and_unconvincing_k2s0.description: While defending, your player and your opponent cannot spend power tokens or play Command cards.

vanguard.label: Vanguard
vanguard.description: While attacking a figure within 3 spaces, you may replace one die in your attack pool with 1 red die.

Vanish.label: Special: cannot suffer Damage or conditions until next activation; then gain 4 MP

versatile_weaponry_hk_elite.label: Versatile Weaponry
versatile_weaponry_hk_elite.description: While attacking, you may force the defender to reroll 1 defense die.

Veteran Instincts.label: Gain 2 Power Tokens (prompted to add +1 Hit/Surge or Block/Evade each roll)
Veteran Instincts.logMessage: Gained **2 Power Tokens**. This activation: you will be prompted to add +1 Hit or Surge on each attack roll, and +1 Block or Evade on each defense roll.

voracious_rancor.label: Voracious
voracious_rancor.description: When another figure activates, Rancor may defeat an adjacent friendly small figure to recover damage.

wall_run.label: Wall Run
wall_run.description: Move a number of spaces up to your Speed. During this movement, you may ignore terrain in spaces that share an edge or corner with a wall.

wanton_destruction_saw.label: Wanton Destruction
wanton_destruction_saw.description: After a friendly attack resolves, you may discard a CC to deal 2 damage to 2 nearby figures.

whats_yours_is_mine_hondo.label: What's Yours is Mine
whats_yours_is_mine_hondo.description: At the end of each round, if you are in the opponent's deployment zone, steal 2 VP.

Whistling Birds.label: Gain 2 MP; roll 1 red die, up to 3 hostiles within 2 suffer Hits as Damage

Wild Attack.label: Add 1 red die to attack pool, 1 white die to defense pool

Wild Fire.label: Remove up to 2 dice from defense pool

Wild Fury.label: Become Focused + up to 3 free attacks; then Stunned + Bleeding
Wild Fury.logMessage: Became Focused. You may perform up to 3 free attacks this activation. After the last free attack (or end of activation), become Stunned and Bleeding.

Windfall.label: When CCs discarded from hand/deck: gain VP equal to their cost
Windfall.logMessage: **Windfall** — When a Command card is discarded from your hand or deck, VPs equal to its cost are awarded automatically. When Windfall itself is discarded, +1 VP is awarded automatically.

wisdom_yoda.label: Wisdom
wisdom_yoda.description: At the start of your activation, draw 1 CC, then place 1 CC from your hand on the bottom of your deck.

Wookiee Rage.label: Choose up to 3 adjacent hostiles; each suffers 1 Damage per your Damage suffered (max 3)

Worth Every Credit.label: Discard 1 harmful condition; gain 2 MP; gain 2 VP when the next hostile is defeated this activation

Wreak Vengeance.label: When using Dual-Bladed Fury: choose both effects instead of 1
Wreak Vengeance.logMessage: **Wreak Vengeance** — When using **Dual-Bladed Fury**, both surge effects are applied automatically (play alongside Dual-Bladed Fury).

wrist_cord.label: Wrist Cord
wrist_cord.description: Once per round, spend 2 MP to push a SMALL figure within 3 spaces adjacent to you.

wrist_flamethrower.label: Wrist Flamethrower
wrist_flamethrower.description: Once per round, spend 2 MP to choose a space within 2 spaces. Each figure on or adjacent suffers 1 Damage + 1 Strain + becomes Weakened.

You Will Not Deny Me.label: Fifth Brother cannot be defeated; ignores conditions; recover 2 Damage on each hostile defeat
You Will Not Deny Me.logMessage: **You Will Not Deny Me** — Place on Fifth Brother. He cannot be defeated and ignores Harmful conditions. When a hostile figure is defeated, he recovers 2 Damage automatically and this card returns to the game box.

cover_fire_ct1701.label: Cover Fire
cover_fire_ct1701.description: After you resolve an attack, distribute 1 Block Token to a friendly figure within 3 spaces. Then, if it did not miss, you may discard 1 condition or Power Token from the target. Limit once per round.
